title: Banned buzzword
explanation: This word is on the banned buzzword list. Describe what the product actually does instead.

guideline.quote: must not appear in any external copy

title: Competitor named in marketing copy
explanation: Competitors may only be named by Legal in approved comparison documents. Refer to "other providers" instead.

guideline.quote: Never name a competitor in marketing copy.

title: Absolute guarantee
explanation: Absolute promises are not allowed. Quote the SLA from the Fact Sheet exactly instead.

title: Unsubstantiated superlative
explanation: Superlatives need written substantiation approved by Legal. Use a factual description instead.

guideline.quote: require written substantiation approved by Legal

title: Informal language
explanation: Avoid slang and text-speak in customer-facing copy.

guideline.quote: Do not use slang, text-speak, or contractions such as "gonna" and "wanna" in customer-facing copy.

title: Multiple exclamation marks
explanation: Never use more than one exclamation mark in a row.

guideline.quote: Never use multiple exclamation marks in a row.

title: Too many exclamation marks
explanation: Limit exclamation marks to one per piece. Lumora Cloud explains before it persuades.

guideline.quote: Limit exclamation marks to one per piece.

title: Emoji not allowed on this channel
explanation: Emoji are only permitted on social channels. Remove it for web, email, and press copy.

guideline.quote: They are not permitted in press releases, emails to customers, or product documentation.

title: More than two emoji in a post
explanation: Social posts may use at most two emoji.

guideline.quote: no more than two per post

title: Incorrect product name
explanation: The product name is written "LumoraSync": one word, capital L and S.

title: Non-descriptive link text
explanation: Link text must describe where the link goes, for example "start your free trial".

guideline.quote: Never use "click here" or "read more" as link text.

title: Pricing disclaimer missing
explanation: Copy that states a price must include the line "Prices exclude applicable taxes."

guideline.quote: Any copy that states a price must include the line "Prices exclude applicable taxes."

insert: Based on internal benchmarks, [Month Year of test].
title: Performance disclaimer missing
explanation: Copy that states a speed or performance figure must include "Based on internal benchmarks" plus the month and year of the test.

guideline.quote: must include "Based on internal benchmarks" and the month and year of the test.
